avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic metabolism and reduce caspofungin levels through non-CYP450 pathways
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, monitor for reduced antifungal efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential hepatic enzyme induction with prolonged use may theoretically affect caspofungin metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; generally considered safe but use with awareness

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hepatic support supplement; no direct interaction expected but use during antifungal therapy warrants monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Acceptable to use; ensure adequate hydration and monitor liver function

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay or reduce absorption of oral formulations if developed; IV formulation unaffected
caution_foods.action: No significant dietary restriction required; can be taken with or without food for IV administration

monitoring_notes: Caspofungin has minimal hepatic metabolism and low drug-drug interaction potential, making supplement interactions uncommon. Monitor for signs of reduced antifungal efficacy (persistent fever, worsening infection) if strong hepatic enzyme inducers are used concurrently.
